_doc: Candidate centrelines for motion.py (robot frame at q = 0, mm). Point = [x, y, z, body, kind]; body = MJCF body the point rides on (trunk_base torso, neck = ID12/ID11 cases and links, neck_pitch = head-pitch bracket, yaw_roll_motion = yaw link + ID13, jaw_soft = head); kind 'tie' = held by a tie or clip, 'guide' = held in a passage or resting on a surface of that body, 'end' = connector end. Head points from the cable-aware exact corridor (corridor.py front-over-top+cables) and, after the Pi top, the current bundle_head tail (routes.json).

routes.name: current-external
routes.description: V1.8 as built: torso tie at the plate notch to the cap-notch hood tie, one free span behind the neck (taut model of the 130 mm service loop)

routes.name: A-minus-y-channel
routes.description: Inside route, -y side: pack exit -> tie on ID12 case near the neck-pitch axis -> straight up behind the -y neck links -> tie on the -y arm of the head-pitch bracket at the head-pitch axis -> up through the lower-shell floor opening -> -y channel between ID13 and the jaw-support/lower-shell collar -> above the servos -> over the Pi top edge (current tail) -> header

routes.name: B-plus-y-gap
routes.description: Inside route, +y side beside the ID11->ID13 servo cable: pack exit -> tie on ID12 case (+y) -> straight up behind the +y neck links -> tie on the +y bracket arm at the head-pitch axis -> floor opening rear +y corner -> gap between the yaw link and the jaw servo ID15 -> above the servos -> over the Pi top (current tail) -> header

routes.name: A2-minus-y-clips
routes.description: Route A with every tie moved next to the joint axis it serves, each held by a clip under an existing screw head (no new holes): from the V1.8 torso exit over the shell top to a torso clip under the -y shell screw S12-horn-025 beside the neck-pitch pivot (6 mm from the axis); neck clip under the -y link screw S11-case-094 (ID11 case); bracket clip under the -y bracket screw S11-horn-040 beside the head-pitch axis (6 mm from it); then up the bracket plate, through the lower-shell floor opening and the -y channel as route A. Wire points sit 3 mm outboard of the screw seat (screw head plus clip plus half a wire).
